description: This file contains an immutable Java class 'ImmutablePolicyEntry' that implements the 'PolicyEntry' interface, representing an immutable model of a policy entry with methods for creation from parameters or JSON, and for serialization. It also defines equality, hashing, and string representation methods.

classes.name: ImmutablePolicyEntry
classes.description: An immutable implementation of the 'PolicyEntry' interface, encapsulating label, subjects, and resources with various factory methods, JSON serialization, and overridden equals, hashCode, and toString methods.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Factory method to create a new ImmutablePolicyEntry with specified label, subjects, and resources.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a new PolicyEntry instance from a JSON object, extracting subjects and resources.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns the label of the policy entry.

methods.name: getSubjects
methods.description: Returns the subjects associated with the policy entry.

methods.name: getResources
methods.description: Returns the resources associated with the policy entry.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes the policy entry to a JSON object given a schema version and a predicate.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Determines equality with another object based on label, subjects, and resources.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes hash code based on label, subjects, and resources.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the ImmutablePolicyEntry instance.
